revisions.goal: Fix the macOS app plan lifecycle bug where an approved plan disappears and is recreated, including the programmatic stale-plan removal path; add a regression test and document the local macOS run/test workflow.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: An approved plan remains visible and is not recreated; stale plans are removed only through the intended lifecycle and the programmatic cleanup path is correct; a deterministic regression test covers the observed bug; relevant tests/build checks pass; the final response explains how to run the macOS app locally.

milestones.title: Reproduce and trace
milestones.goal: Build a deterministic red-capable regression loop and trace approval, refresh, and stale-plan removal across the macOS app/backend.

milestones.title: Implement fix
milestones.goal: Correct the lifecycle and programmatic removal behavior with focused regression coverage.

milestones.title: Verify and record
milestones.goal: Run relevant tests/build checks, capture the product history record, and provide local macOS run instructions.
